_comment: Aurochs. The wild cattle the herds came out of - big, bad-tempered and worth four deer dead. A calf taken young is the beginning of a herd, which is the only reason anybody goes near one (D111).
name: aurochs
label: Aurochs

_comment: Cattle. Slow to breed and expensive to keep, and worth it: a cow gives milk through most of the year and one beast dead feeds a household for a fortnight. A herd is the largest thing a community owns.
name: cattle
label: Cattle
